verdicts.reason: A has a strong headline and a sensible two-column split, but the subtitle is set so large it competes with the headline. The flavour pills are in reverse order, and the right column is jammed against the top and right edges. B puts the SOLSTICE logo below the headline, which breaks the reading order, and shrinks the subtitle to tiny text. Its pills are scrambled in order and inconsistent in size (Honey Rosemary is far larger than the other two), and the left-aligned headline clashes with the centred stack beneath it.
